_about: Real bugs from Actual Budget (github.com/actualbudget/actual, MIT). Each was fixed upstream in 2026; the benchmark re-creates it by reverse-applying the real fix to today's code, then replays a complaint written from the real report. The real fix is the answer key.

cases.note: Native date picker: the browser draws it outside the page. Needed new evidence (picker_not_opened, Oct 17).
cases.complaint: On my Android phone, when I add a transaction and tap the date, the calendar never opens. I can't change the date at all.

cases.note: Needs an already reconciled transaction; those are marked only by a lock icon with no text.
cases.complaint: On my phone the Reconciled switch on a transaction does nothing when I tap it. The Cleared switch works fine.

cases.note: A missing feature (no way to clear a payee): machine evidence can show something broken, not something absent.
cases.complaint: On my phone I picked the wrong payee for a new transaction and now there is no way to clear the payee again.

cases.note: Wrong running balance: only an app-specific check (`checks` in the config) can know the right number.
cases.complaint: On my phone, with hide reconciled transactions turned on, the balance next to the oldest transaction in an account is wrong. It just shows that transaction's own amount.

cases.note: Reproduces every run (typed amount lost after tapping Cleared). The fixer sees the right file but patches the caller.
cases.complaint: On my phone I type the amount for a new transaction and then tap the Cleared switch, and the amount I typed disappears.

cases.note: Keyboard-only user in a large desktop app: the hardest navigation of the set.
cases.complaint: I only use the keyboard. When I choose a category for a transaction with the arrow keys and press Enter, a different category gets saved than the one that was highlighted.

cases.note: Row select boxes are focusable divs, invisible to the twin until Oct 17.
cases.complaint: When I select several transactions and use bulk edit to change the date, the date field looks broken and squashed.

cases.note: Shows only when a month other than the current one is on screen; the complaint does not say so.
cases.complaint: In the guided tour, the To Budget step highlights nothing I can see. The highlight points somewhere off the screen.
